claim: Yountville's restaurants, tasting rooms and shops line Washington Street for about three-quarters of a mile, making the downtown highly walkable.
quote: Tasting rooms, shops, and Yountville's main attraction—its many stellar restaurants—line Washington Street for ¾ mile between Madison Street and California Drive.

claim: V Marketplace occupies three 1870 stone winery buildings and now houses specialty shops, art galleries, restaurants and a wine-tasting cellar.
quote: V Marketplace is located in three 1870 stone buildings that once housed a winery, barrel room and distillery, and today it's home to restaurants, galleries and boutiques.

claim: Yountville's Art Walk is a self-guided, strollable collection of over 35 rotating outdoor sculptures along Washington Street, with maps and an audio tour from the Welcome Center.
quote: over 35 rotating outdoor sculptures from local and world renowned artists ... The Welcome Center provides Art Walk maps and audio tours for self-guided exploration

claim: The 14th annual Art, Sip & Stroll returns to downtown Yountville on May 16, 2026 with 80+ juried artists, wineries, live music and free admission.
quote: The 14th Annual Art, Sip & Stroll returns to downtown Yountville on May 16, 2026—with 80+ juried artists, Napa Valley wineries, live music, and free admission.

claim: RH Yountville offers dining under crystal chandeliers (charcuterie boards, burgers, lobster rolls, roasted chicken) plus the RH Wine Vault tastings in a 1904 stone building.
quote: RH Yountville offers dining under crystal chandeliers on cheese and charcuterie boards, a splendid burger, lobster rolls, roasted chicken ... RH Wine Vault is a historic 1904 stone building

claim: The Napa Valley Museum at 55 Presidents Circle, Yountville is open Tuesday-Sunday 10am-6pm, closed Mondays, with $5 adult admission and three rotating galleries.
quote: Hours are Tuesday-Sunday, 10am-6pm ... Admission is free for members, $5 for adults, $3.50 for seniors, $2.50 for youth under 17 ... located at 55 Presidents Circle, Yountville, CA 94599

claim: Thomas Keller's Bouchon Bistro in Yountville serves authentic French bistro fare and earned a Michelin star; its adjacent Bouchon Bakery offers baguettes, macarons and pastries.
quote: In 1998, Chef Thomas Keller decided to dedicate a new restaurant concept to authentic French bistro fare and opened The Bouchon Bistro ... led the Michelin Guide to award a star to Bouchon.

claim: Beyond The French Laundry, Keller runs Ad Hoc + Addendum (daily-changing family-style American comfort food) and La Calenda (Oaxacan-inspired Mexican) in Yountville.
quote: Ad Hoc + Addendum is a casual restaurant that features a family-style four-course menu that changes daily ... La Calenda ... draws inspiration from the Oaxacan region of Mexico.

claim: Non-Keller Yountville dining anchors include Philippe Jeanty's French Bistro Jeanty (opened 1998) and nearby Mustards Grill, Cindy Pawlcyn's long-running American grill.
quote: Bistro Jeanty ... casual spot with serious French comfort food ... Mustards Grill, owned by chef Cindy Pawlcyn for 30 years, knows how to put a sophisticated spin on hearty dishes.

claim: St. Helena's Model Bakery has operated since 1908 on Main Street, baking from 1920s ovens and famous for English muffins featured on Oprah's Favorite Things.
quote: Oprah has given Model Bakery her seal of approval with their English muffins ... the flagship store has been in business since 1908 with ovens from the 1920s where they make 5,000 English muffins every day.

claim: St. Helena, nicknamed Napa Valley's Main Street, has shops, galleries and cafes in historic buildings and marks its 150th anniversary in 2026.
quote: Nicknamed "Napa Valley's Main Street," the downtown area of St. Helena features lovely little shops, art galleries, and precious cafés set in historic buildings ... St. Helena marks its 150th anniversary

claim: The CIA at Greystone, a National Register historic former Christian Brothers winery in St. Helena, offers the Gatehouse Restaurant, The Bakery Cafe and the Spice Islands Marketplace store.
quote: Built in the late 19th century and listed on the National Register of Historic Places, Greystone in St. Helena was once home to the Christian Brothers Winery ... dining in the Gatehouse Restaurant, espresso and pastry from The Bakery Cafe, and shopping in the Spice Islands Marketplace.

claim: Beringer Vineyards at 2000 Main Street, St. Helena is Napa's oldest continuously operating winery (1876), with landscaped grounds and the ornate 1884 Victorian Rhine House to stroll.
quote: Beringer Vineyards is Napa Valley's oldest continuously operating winery, established in 1876 ... the 17-room Rhine House was built in 1884 ... sit on the expansive porch while taking in the gorgeously landscaped grounds.

claim: St. Helena is about 9.3 miles (15 km) from Yountville, roughly a 15-16 minute drive in normal traffic.
quote: The direct drive from Yountville to St. Helena is 9.3 miles (15 km), with a drive time of 15 minutes in normal traffic.

claim: Charles Krug at 2800 Main Street is Napa Valley's first winery (1861), offering estate tours, outdoor tastings and cheese/charcuterie on its grounds in St. Helena.
quote: Charles Krug winery was established by winemaker Charles Krug in 1861 as the Napa Valley's first winery ... options including outdoor tastings and artisan cheese and charcuterie.
